_meta.note: v2 (world-map W55): adds the `development` block beside `upkeep.developmentUpkeepPerLevel` — empire-economy-ssot.md A8 is a comparison between the two, so both live in this one file where the invariant is readable by inspection. Every other key is byte-identical to v1. `yieldPerLevel` is a provisional placeholder, chosen only to keep A8 true at publish time (6 > upkeep.developmentUpkeepPerLevel's 5) — L9's economy harness, not this migration, picks the real number. Kept deliberately close to 5 rather than a rounder, larger number: A8 makes any positive DevelopmentLevel a genuine net producer now (yield always exceeds its own upkeep), which several pre-existing Loam-domain test fixtures had used purely as an upkeep-only lever assuming no such side effect — those fixtures were repaired to use DangerBand instead (world-map W55's own audit), and a smaller margin here keeps the two concerns (a real A8 economy number vs. an arbitrary test fixture number) from silently colliding again the next time either moves.
